name: AppMarketplace
intent: Browse, inspect, install and uninstall apps, and derive the installed-apps navigation group from what is installed.
when: A portal offers an app catalogue
The sidebar's app list must follow the install state
Grouping apps by project lifecycle stage
whenNot: Installing an ontology product -> use InstallProductDialog
A static nav list that never changes -> declare the group directly

chooseOver.because: Four templates already import this module; the install lifecycle and the nav group derived from it must agree across all of them, and a per-template copy guarantees they eventually will not.

initialInstalled.note: App ids installed at mount; they also count as already opened, so no 'new' dot shows.

onUninstalled.note: Lets the host react when an app leaves the workspace.

dataContract.rowIdentity: Apps are keyed by id; lifecycle stage is nav metadata, not behaviour.

states.installed: The app appears in the derived nav group.
states.uninstalled: It leaves the group; an empty stage disappears.

minimalExample:
import {useAppInstallation, installedAppsGroup} from "@corensystem/coren-ui/pages/app-marketplace";

const install = useAppInstallation({initialInstalled: ["safety", "workforce"]});
evaluationCriteria: The nav group is derived from install state, never declared twice.
Lifecycle stage is treated as nav metadata, not behaviour.

lineage.authoredBy: Promoted from the shared module four Connect templates already import (2026-08-26)
notes: Already the repo's best-behaved shared module — imported by core-app-installer, core-core-connect, core-core-connect-v3 and core-wc3-workspace. It had earned widget tier by use and simply had not been given it.
Promoted in group B of the missing-widgets template review.
